# Adopt-A-Bench, Riverbend Park

> A bench adoption service for a park: see which of 532 benches are adopted, by whom and until when, and request a plaque on one. Built as a take-home for Columbia Software Solutions, simulating the Van Cortlandt Park Alliance program (prices, term and form fields follow VCPA's).

## Pages

- / : the park map. Every bench is a pin (open, one of two plaques open, adopted, spot for a new bench). Click a pin for status, donor and term; "Adopt this plaque" opens the request form with the plaque held for 10 minutes.
- /about : how the program works, prices ($3,500 existing bench, $5,500 new bench, ten-year term), FAQ.
- /areas/{id} : one area of the park with its benches.
- /benches/{id} : one bench, photographed, with its plaques; the request form.

## How it works

- The unit of adoption is a plaque position (an 8 ft bench has two, a 4 ft bench one).
- Opening the form reserves the plaque for 10 minutes; submitting creates a request; park staff approve or reject it. Approval starts the ten-year term.
- The database enforces one live adoption per plaque with a partial unique index; there are no accounts and no online payment.
